content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the banking system collapsed, and PayPal and Stripe were unavailable, COREMERCH's infrastructure allowed digital creators to sell ebooks and digital products without relying on platforms that could restrict or shut them down. You can replicate this infrastructure to accept Bitcoin for ebook sales, bypassing Gumroad's 10% fee and building a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|Sovereign Commerce]] digital commerce stack. You'll retain more revenue and maintain control of your products and infrastructure. The Sovereign Stack is a good starting point, but you can customize and scale it with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. If you're new to this, start with the Sovereign Blueprint, which includes complete documentation and source code for all 5 stacks. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-plugins-without-payment-processor-what-nobody-tells|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-stock-photos-without-5|difference]] is $921, a significant advantage over platforms like Gumroad. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can process transactions in USD, converted at transaction time, and deliver products automatically via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, a fraction of Gumroad's 10% fee. This infrastructure is not just a workaround but a base-layer solution that empowers digital creators to build and manage their own commerce stacks.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you own the entire stack, including the hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a GitHub account or Cloudflare account, depending on your hosting preference. You'll also need to install Cloudflare Pages or Cloudflare Workers, depending on your backend logic requirements. For order storage, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets. For file delivery, you can use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. For payment processing, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen stack. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to help you customize and scale your infrastructure. By the end of this guide, you'll have a fully operational sovereign digital commerce stack that accepts Bitcoin for ebook sales.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen stack. This involves installing the NOWPayments plugin and setting up the payment gateway. You'll also need to configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automatically deliver products after payment confirmation. With Cloudflare Workers, you can create custom delivery logic using JavaScript. With Google Apps Script, you can use Google Sheets to store orders and deliver products automatically. By integrating NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you'll create a seamless payment and delivery process that empowers customers to purchase ebooks and digital products directly from your website.
By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate product delivery and reduce the workload on your team.

By going live and processing your first transaction, you'll validate your infrastructure and ensure that it's working as expected. You can monitor your transactions and delivery pipeline to identify areas for improvement and optimize your infrastructure for better performance.
